# truenas_vm_start (Action)

Starts a VM (vm.start). No-op when the VM is already running, so it is safe to trigger repeatedly — e.g. after each truenas_vm_device is created.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) ID of the VM to start (truenas_vm.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `overcommit` (Boolean) Allow starting even if it would overcommit host memory (vm.start's overcommit option).
